request.reason: PR #1019 exact-head run 37263602059 passed Windows and candidate hosted verification but the Rust Contract gate failed closed with repository_material_inspection_unavailable. A source-bound local replay isolated the scanner's current limitations: whole-file recursive 16,384-token mask budget rejects the 24,371-token CLI source before changed-origin semantics; a changed large json! macro is treated as one unresolved token string; and item-level .join() ambiguity conflates Path::join with string composition. Raydot's ordinary technical decision authorizes one bounded same-WI correction; preserve all previous pass/failure evidence, do not weaken the gate, raise the semantic budget, move tests, or bypass Runtime/CI.

changes.value: Rust material inspection must remain fail-closed while correctly classifying legitimate scoped changes that currently return Unknown: perform a bounded whole-file lexical boundary pass but apply the existing 16,384-token semantic budget to changed-origin and cross-line lexical context, without increasing that semantic limit; incomplete provenance/context or truly over-budget changed context remains Unknown. Parse only supported bounded json! object/array syntax and inspect keys and each value independently; do not join unrelated sibling values. Follow supported static concat!, simple format!, literal bindings and pure-literal function references within one value; a directly inspectable malicious literal/static malicious combination remains Finding, while unresolved candidate macros, dynamic command composition, or unsupported syntax remains Unknown. Add RED-to-GREEN regressions showing benign json! action data and proven Path::join with unrelated risky-word literals are Clean; direct and static JSON-value injection are Findings; candidate dynamic JSON values, unknown-receiver join and string composition are Unknown. Preserve existing cross-line comment, provenance mismatch, oversized changed-context, marker/operation, and all current fixture-boundary regressions. Do not weaken the gate or simply increase its prior whole-file token threshold.

After archive, inspect real exact-head PR CI route, formal receipt or archived read-only lane as applicable, Rust gate, repository gates and workspace coverage before merge; after installation, reverify WI-1065 separately.
